title: Risk Measures and Upper Probabilities: Coherence and Stratification
reasoning: The paper frames the problem of fair machine learning as an ethical one, discussing the distribution of loss values among 'ethically fungible individuals' (e.g., based on race, gender). It connects its mathematical framework to concepts from distributive justice and social choice theory, explicitly referencing the ethical theories of John Harsanyi and John Rawls as analogues for different types of risk measures. This integration of ethical frameworks is a core part of the paper's conceptual contribution.
